title: Store stages
subtitle: Each store's stage at Stock Visibility and its last move. Open a store for its log and to move its stage.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the store stage grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

list.failedTitle: The stages could not be read
list.failed: Stock Visibility did not answer. Try again in a moment.

note: A person can put any store back to Shadow, move a Seeded store to Blocking and a Blocking store back to Seeded. Shadow to Seeding is the count's closing and Seeding to Seeded is the seed's: no person writes them.

log.title: Stage log
log.empty: This store's stage has never moved.
log.failedTitle: The log could not be read
log.failed: Stock Visibility did not answer. Try again in a moment.

move.title: Move this store's stage
move.whyPlaceholder: The reason, kept in the store's log
move.tooLong: The reason is longer than {{max}} characters.
move.failed: The stage could not be moved. Try again in a moment.
move.noneFromShadow: A Shadow store moves on only when its count closes.

blocking.title: Before Blocking
blocking.confirmHint: Confirm each by name: you read its figures.
blocking.waiveHint: Each failing fleet gate is waived by name, and the waiver is logged with its failing figure.
blocking.noWaiveGrant: Fails. Only a holder of the block-early permission may waive it.
blocking.storeFailing: The store's own proof does not hold ({{gates}}). It is never waived, so the move would be refused.
blocking.needsGates: The gates must be read before a store moves to Blocking.

count.title: Count
count.none: This store is not under count.
count.open: Under count, open: sales dated after the count day are held.
count.closed: Count closed by {{who}} at {{at}}: every sale and every DRS post of the store is held until its seed writes Seeded.
count.closeHint: Holds every sale and DRS post of the store, moves it to Seeding and asks its seed. The store is released when the seed writes Seeded.
count.failedTitle: The count could not be closed
count.failed: The count could not be closed. Try again in a moment.
count.readFailed: The store's count could not be read.
count.seedRefusedTitle: The seed was refused: the store stays held
count.seedRunning: Stock Visibility is seeding this store: it counts the store against SAP and reads its batch stock, which can take several minutes. This page follows it. The store stays held until the seed ends.
count.seedFailedTitle: The seed did not finish: the store stays held
count.reopened: The seed found sales of the count day or earlier that are not in SAP yet. A closed count holds those sales too, so the count was opened again: they now go on to SAP, and later sales stay held. Press Count closed again once they are posted.

start.hint: Starts the store's count: from the count day its sales dated after that day are held from SAP until the count is closed and seeded.
start.inFuture: The count day cannot be after today.
start.refusedTitle: The count could not be started
start.failed: The count could not be started. Try again in a moment.

cancel.title: Cancel this count
cancel.hint: Only for a count started by mistake, before it is closed. The store's held sales go on to SAP.
cancel.whyPlaceholder: The reason, kept in the count log
cancel.refusedTitle: The count could not be cancelled
cancel.failed: The count could not be cancelled. Try again in a moment.

released.title: Count released
released.detail: {{store}} is Seeded; its count row is deleted.

release.title: Release this closed count by hand
release.hint: Only after a refused seed. The store goes back to Shadow and is seeded at its next count.
release.whyPlaceholder: The reason, kept in the release log
release.failed: The count could not be released. Try again in a moment.

done.title: Count released
done.detail: {{store}} is released and back to Shadow.

releases.title: Count log
releases.empty: Nothing is logged for this store's counts yet.
releases.failed: The releases could not be read.

kind.Reopened: Opened again: sales still on their way to SAP

gates.title: Gates toward Blocking
gates.hint: Measured now by Stock Visibility, as a move to Blocking would measure them. The store's own proof always refuses when it fails; a failing fleet gate may be waived by name.
gates.failedTitle: The gates could not be read
gates.failed: Stock Visibility did not answer. Try again in a moment.
gates.fleet: The fleet's gates (a failing one may be waived by name)

confirm.StoreTills: The store's tills answer takes in time
confirm.DrsHoldsInShadow: DRS holds held 30 days in shadow
confirm.DeliverySalesPicked: Delivery sales carry a picking document
confirm.TillsOnHoldSeam: Every till is on the hold-seam engine
confirm.OldDocumentsCleared: Old picking documents are written off
confirm.FeedForcedStop: The feeds' forced stop proved the restart and the alarm
confirm.TakeDoorSkips: Skipped and failed takes stay under 1 in 1,000 a day
confirm.WouldBeRefusalsRead: I read the store's would-be refusals
